Crossing Lines / Canal Quarter
48 × 48 inches; 300 points.
Terrain fitted to objective footprints and walking routes.
Each player has a rear 12-inch zone and a separate central 4-inch zone. Side A central zone is south of center; Side B central zone is north of center. Superior Deployment restrictions apply.
Official mission: https://experience.corvusbelli.com/en/game-content/cb03446d-da08-4367-8eb9-9ddf87c8612f
Geometry revision: TTS engine and visual review still required.

Deployment: take this bag into the normal Infinity mod and drop it onto its map deployment spot.
